en.name: Mascarpone
en.summary: Mascarpone is cream set with acid and never ripened — a high-fat, high-moisture, only mildly acidic fresh cheese. Unopened it keeps about 2 weeks in the fridge; once the tub is open, 5–6 days. Freezing breaks it, so no freezer timeline is given.
en.pantry: There is no counter life for mascarpone. It is an unripened fresh cheese with almost no acidity to protect it, which is the profile food-safety agencies describe as favourable to Listeria monocytogenes, an organism that grows even at 0 °C. Keep it cold, buy it pasteurised, and follow the 2-hour rule when it is out of the fridge — 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Let it soften slightly before whipping rather than leaving it out for an hour.
en.fridge: Unopened, mascarpone keeps about 2 weeks at 0–5 °C or to the printed date, whichever comes first; that figure is borrowed from what is published for cream cheese. Once opened, use it within 5–6 days, which is the published line for opened soft cream cheese. Press the surface flat, cover it against the tub so no air sits on top, and never return a used spoon. A dessert built on raw mascarpone and raw egg — tiramisù — is a leftovers problem in its own right: raw egg carries a Salmonella risk that no amount of chilling removes, so keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and treat it as a two-day dish, or make it with pasteurised egg.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given, because it is not worth it: mascarpone breaks into butter grains and water on thawing and cannot be whipped back. If you have a tub you cannot finish, cook it out — folded into a hot pasta sauce, a risotto or a baked cheesecake, all of which hide a slightly broken texture. Buying the small tub is a better plan than freezing the large one.
spoilage: Any mould on the surface or under the lid, even a single spot.
A sour, yeasty or sharply acidic smell instead of a sweet creamy one.
Watery separation with a grainy, split texture.
A bitter, fizzy or cheesy taste.
tips: Buy the small tub; this is not a cheese that waits.
Press the surface flat and lay cling film directly on it.
Clean spoon every time, without exception.
Use pasteurised egg for tiramisù, and keep it cold and eat it quickly.

faq.q: How long does mascarpone last once opened?
faq.a: About 5–6 days at 0–5 °C. Unopened it keeps about 2 weeks, or to the printed date if that comes first.
No timeline is given because freezing breaks it into grains and water. Use up a surplus in a cooked sauce or a baked dessert instead.
Treat it as a two-day dish at 4 °C or below. It is built on raw mascarpone and usually raw egg, which carries a Salmonella risk; pasteurised egg is the safer choice.
Choose a pasteurised one and keep it properly cold. It is a fresh, low-acid cheese, and Listeria grows at refrigerator temperature. Avoid desserts made with raw egg.

zh.name: 馬斯卡彭乳酪
zh.summary: 馬斯卡彭是用酸讓鮮奶油凝固、完全不熟成的新鮮乳酪，脂肪高、水分高、酸度卻很低。未開封冷藏大約 2 週；開盒之後 5～6 天。冷凍會讓它分離，所以這裡不給冷凍期限。
zh.pantry: 馬斯卡彭沒有室溫保存這回事。它是未熟成的新鮮乳酪，幾乎沒有酸度保護，而這正是各國食品安全單位形容為「有利於李斯特菌」的條件——這種菌連 0 °C 都能生長。請保持低溫、選巴氏殺菌品，離開冰箱後守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時）。要打發之前讓它稍微回軟就好，不要整盒放在外面一小時。
zh.fridge: 未開封在 0～5 °C 下大約 2 週，或以包裝日期為準（取先到者）；這個數字借自奶油乳酪的公告值。開盒之後請在 5～6 天內用完，這是「已開封軟質奶油乳酪」的公告值。表面壓平、保鮮膜直接貼住，不要留空氣，用過的湯匙絕不回鍋。用生馬斯卡彭加生蛋做的甜點——提拉米蘇——本身就是一個剩菜難題：生蛋帶有沙門氏菌風險，冷藏再久也不會消失，所以請放 4 °C 以下，並把它當成兩天內吃完的甜點，或改用殺菌蛋液製作。
zh.freezer: 這裡不給冷凍期限，因為不值得：馬斯卡彭解凍後會分離成油粒和水，打也打不回來。用不完的話就加熱用掉——拌進熱義大利麵醬、燉飯，或做成烤起司蛋糕，這些都能藏住稍微分離的質地。與其冷凍大盒，不如一開始就買小盒。
spoilage: 表面或蓋內出現任何霉點，哪怕只有一點。
聞起來發酸、有酵母味或尖銳酸味，而不是香甜的奶味。
出水分離，質地變得粗糙破碎。
吃起來發苦、有氣泡感或起司臭味。
tips: 買小盒；這種乳酪不會等你。
表面壓平，保鮮膜直接貼在上面。
每次都用乾淨的湯匙，沒有例外。
做提拉米蘇請用殺菌蛋液，全程冷藏並盡快吃完。

faq.q: 馬斯卡彭開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 0～5 °C 下約 5～6 天。未開封約 2 週，或以包裝日期為準。
這裡不給期限，因為冷凍會讓它分離成顆粒和水。剩下的請用在加熱醬汁或烘焙甜點上。
放 4 °C 以下並當成兩天內要吃完的甜點。它用的是生馬斯卡彭和通常是生的蛋，有沙門氏菌風險；用殺菌蛋液比較安全。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃馬斯卡彭嗎？
faq.a: 請選巴氏殺菌品並全程冷藏。它是低酸的新鮮乳酪，而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會生長。含生蛋的甜點請避免。
